title: The Sitter: Checkmate
description:
The epic conclusion to the legendary series.
....
Things with the sitter have gotten very out of hand…
....
One of the neighbors told your wife the sitter has been staying with you while she has been visiting her parents…
....
She is kind, and willing to forgive, and work things out… but she hates the sitter, and doesn’t want her in the house ever again….
....
The walls are closing in….
....
Are you a good boy?
author: Goddess Nichole
